mechanism: Pantoprazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing clarithromycin plasma concentrations and risk of adverse effects; clarithromycin may also inhibit pantoprazole metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for clarithromycin toxicity (QT prolongation, arrhythmias, GI effects); consider dose adjustment or alternative antibiotic if QT prolongation risk factors present.
